# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book is my journey and record of learning **R** using [*R for Data Science* (2nd edition)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) by Hadley and company.

Started these notes on 20 July 2026. They began as plain R scripts that I wrote for myself as I worked through the book, and I've turned them into this Quarto book or whatever!

## What's in here

So far I've worked through:

- @sec-data-visualisation: making plots with ggplot2
- @sec-workflow-basics: the basics of writing R code
- @sec-data-transformation: filtering, sorting, and summarising data with dplyr
- @sec-code-style: writing tidy, readable code
- @sec-data-tidying: reshaping data with tidyr (still in progress)

More chapters will be added as I go.

## How to read this book

::: callout-note
These are learning notes, not a textbook – take them with a the largest pinch of salt you ca find. They show my attempts, my mistakes, and what I worked out along the way, so expect some rough edges.
:::

- Every code chunk is real R code, and the output you see was produced when the book was built.
- Some code is shown but not run, for example code that only works in RStudio or installs packages.
- Some code fails **on purpose**, to show what a particular error looks like.
- The exercises come from the R4DS book, and the answers are my own attempts. They may not be perfect, and corrections are welcome.
